where: Section 1, sentence after the DTFT-sampling paragraph
problem: "The DFT is exact at those points; it says nothing between them" overstates the case. The DTFT between bins is completely fixed by the same N samples (it is the sinc-interpolated curve), so zero padding later in the chapter does reveal values between the N bins. A student can read this sentence and conclude that nothing between bins exists.
fix: "The DFT gives N values of X(ejω) and no samples in between. The full DTFT curve is fixed by the same N samples, and zero padding shows more of it."

problem: "|X[k]|² is the energy of bin k" contradicts the 1/N in the formula: the energy carried by bin k is |X[k]|²/N, not |X[k]|². The later quiz answer says the bins are divided by N, so the two statements disagree.
fix: "|X[k]|²/N is the energy in bin k; the sum over all bins equals the time-domain energy."

problem: The steps are compressed to "X[1] = 1 − (−1) = 2" and "X[3] = 1 − (−1) = 2" with no visible substitution. A student cannot see where the −(−1) comes from, because the term x[2] = −1 and W4² = −1 are multiplied without being shown.
The sum is typed as "Σn=0N−1 x[n] WNnk", which reads as a product chain, not a summation with limits and a power. Read on a phone, a student may copy the limits wrongly.
fix: "X[k] = Σ<sub>n=0</sub><sup>N−1</sup> x[n] W<sub>N</sub><sup>nk</sup>, for k = 0, 1, ..., N−1."
